tools.name: get_shopping_decision
tools.description: Provides read-only shopping recommendations, product comparisons, purchase-timing context, and basket plans for physical products sold in Greece. Accepts only a concise current shopping request with a budget, required specifications, and relevant corrections, excluding chat transcripts and unrelated

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Searches physical products sold in Greece by product name, model, category, or barcode and returns up to eight grouped products with canonical product IDs, catalog prices, relevance warnings, and BestPrice links. Price bounds apply before shipping; feature hints are not independently verified. A val

tools.name: compare_offers
tools.description: Compares current Greek merchant offers for one exact grouped BestPrice product ID. Returns public store names, item prices, shipping information, calculable delivered totals, ranking reasons, and BestPrice links. Without objective it ranks by lowest_total_cost when postal_code is given and by lowest

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Returns historical prices and a deterministic deal classification for one exact grouped BestPrice product ID. Includes minimum and median statistics, a compact daily price series, coverage gaps, and methodology. period_days selects the daily series and coverage gaps only: deal_classification and pri

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
